title: Explicit coefficient coordinates for compactified integral tensor and support
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a coefficient datum C with prime ℓ distinct from the characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_ℓ, n≥1, and a normalized six-functor operation datum S at n. Assume ℓ is invertible in D.k. Let o be simultaneous-system operations and z their canonical realization data. Let f:X→Y be separated, locally of finite type and quasi-compact between finite-type schemes over D.k. Let H=S.higher. Construct these specified comparisons, also defined for any such higher-operation data H. On a constructible integral object, reconstruction is the inverse of the reduction/limit unit. Completed tensor and pullback reduce via the specified completion comparisons and the actual reconstruction counit. The datum tensor and pullback are identified using the stipulated operation equalities in H. For a compactification c and constructible integral K, supportValue is the composite of proper/limit conjugation, limit applied to the open reduction mate, inverse open reconstruction unit, the qcqs compact-support realization, and the datum support-value equality. Define supportReduction to be the adjoint of supportValue inverse, from reduction of H.integral.support(f,c)(K) to system support of reduction K. For constructible K on X and L on Y, inputReduction identifies the system tensor of reduction K with system pullback of reduction L with reduction of the datum tensor/pullback input. Define sourceMap by the tensor reduction comparison followed by supportReduction tensored with identity. Define targetMap by supportReduction on the tensor/pullback input followed by the system support functor applied to inverse inputReduction. No invertibility or arrow-compatibility assertion for these three maps is part of the definition.
